'''Tiber Saxon's Star Destroyer''' was an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] owned by [[Tiber Saxon]], [[Governor]] of [[Mandalore]]. It was based outside the [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Sundari]] during a [[mission to Mandalore]] undertaken by [[Clan Wren]], [[Clan Kryze]], and several members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] to destroy the [[Arc Pulse Generator|''Duchess'']], an arc generator that was contained within the [[AT-DP Arc Cannon Prototype]]. By the end of the mission, the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] was destroyed, along with "the [[Arc Pulse Generator|Duchess]]," the AT-DP Arc Cannon Prototype, and Saxon, with the [[Starship|ship]] crashing near the base of Sundari.<ref name="Heroes of Mandalore" />
